ratios.facility: Credit Facility ($900 million unsecured revolving credit facility)
Credit Facility ($900 million unsecured revolving credit facility)

parsed.notes: The Credit Facility leverage ratio is a debt-to-capitalization type measure with a 60% maximum, so it is expressed as a decimal (0.60 limit, 0.02 actual), not a debt/EBITDA multiple. The interest coverage covenant is an either/or test: the company must meet either the minimum 1.5x Interest Coverage Ratio or a minimum available liquidity amount. Dollar-amount covenants were not included as ratios: Consolidated Tangible Net Worth (≥$2,172.7M; actual $3,061.4M) and Investments in Unrestricted Subsidiaries and JVs (≤$918.4M; actual $6.8M). Also excluded: the M/I Financial mortgage repurchase facility covenants (Leverage Ratio ≤12.0 to 1.0, actual 8.05 to 1.0; liquidity; tangible net worth). These are warehouse repurchase facilities of the mortgage subsidiary, not the bank credit agreement.
